title: Finite derived Hom comparison: invertibility, evaluation and transposition
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, $n\geq0$, and $g:X\xrightarrow{\sim}Y$ a scheme isomorphism with $\ell$ invertible on $X$ and $Y$. Use the finite derived pullback $F=Lg^*$, derived tensor $T$, internal Hom $H$, evaluation $\mathrm{ev}$ and closed transposition $(-)^\sharp$ at $A_{E,n+1}$ [def-sf-finite-rational-derived-operations], the canonical tensor comparison $\mu$ [def-pur-finite-pullback-tensor-comparison], and the finite evaluation-defined comparison $c_{M,N}:FH(M,N)\to H(FM,FN)$ [def-pod-system-hom-reindexing-maps]. Then for all $L,M,N\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n+1})$: (i) $c_{M,N}$ is an isomorphism; (ii) $\mathrm{ev}_{FM,FN}\circ T(c_{M,N},1_{FM})\circ\mu_{H(M,N),M}=F(\mathrm{ev}_{M,N})$; (iii) for every $b:T(L,M)\to N$, $(F(b)\circ\mu^{-1}_{L,M})^\sharp=c_{M,N}\circ F(b^\sharp)$.

proof.text: (i) Reindexing along the isomorphism of sites is an exact equivalence preserving K-flat and K-injective complexes, products and total tensor; its product-Hom comparison $c^0$ is an isomorphism for arbitrary unbounded inputs [lem-pod-reindexing-hom-resolution-model]. The evaluation calculus identifies $c^0$ with the evaluation-defined comparison $c_{M,N}$ [lem-pod-reindexing-evaluation-shift-composition, def-pod-system-hom-reindexing-maps]; hence $c_{M,N}$ is invertible.

(ii) $c_{M,N}$ is the transpose of $F(\mathrm{ev}_{M,N})\circ\mu^{-1}$ [def-pod-system-hom-reindexing-maps]; the counit identity of the closed adjunction [def-sf-finite-rational-derived-operations] gives $\mathrm{ev}\circ T(c_{M,N},1)=F(\mathrm{ev}_{M,N})\circ\mu^{-1}$, and precomposing with $\mu$ gives (ii).

(iii) Transpose both sides. By parameter naturality of transposition and (ii), the right side transposes to $F(\mathrm{ev}_{M,N})\circ\mu^{-1}_{H(M,N),M}\circ T(F(b^\sharp),1)$; naturality of $\mu$ [def-pur-finite-pullback-tensor-comparison] makes this $F(\mathrm{ev}_{M,N}\circ T(b^\sharp,1))\circ\mu^{-1}_{L,M}=F(b)\circ\mu^{-1}_{L,M}$, the transpose of the left side.

lean.statement:
theorem podFiniteHomComparison_laws_remaining (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ M N, IsIso (podFiniteHomComparison l E g n M N)) ∧
    (∀ M N,
      (canonicalFinitePullbackTensor l E g n
        ((finiteIntrinsicDerivedInternalHom l E Y n).obj (op M, N)) M).hom ≫
      (finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor l E X n).map
        (Prod.mkHom (podFiniteHomComparison l E g n M N) (𝟙 _)) ≫
      finiteIntrinsicEvaluation l E X n
        ((finiteDerivedPullback l E n g).obj M) ((finiteDerivedPullback l E n g).obj N) =
      (finiteDerivedPullback l E n g).map (finiteIntrinsicEvaluation l E Y n M N)) ∧
    (∀ L M N (b : (finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor l E Y n).obj (L, M) ⟶ N),
      finiteIntrinsicTranspose l E X n _ _ _
        ((canonicalFinitePullbackTensor l E g n L M).inv ≫
          (finiteDerivedPullback l E n g).map b) =
      (finiteDerivedPullback l E n g).map (finiteIntrinsicTranspose l E Y n L M N b) ≫
        podFiniteHomComparison l E g n M N)
